# Tencent Cloud fixtures

Messages copied from the examples in Tencent Cloud docs, 语音识别 › 实时语音翻译（WebSocket）
(<https://cloud.tencent.com/document/product/1093/127565>, page updated 2026-05-27):
“请求响应”, “接收消息” and the error example. `sign-example.txt` is the string-to-sign printed in
“signature 签名生成” step 1 (the documentation masks its sample AppId, SecretId and SecretKey).
